anticipated_failure_modes: Curvature is not constant for a nonlinear model. lambda_max is evaluated at initialization but grows during training; progressive sharpening / edge-of-stability could drive a cell with rho < 1 at init across the boundary later. This would falsify the prediction as stated, and is the most likely way it fails.
ReLU is only positively homogeneous, so the orbit is exact only for s > 0. All frozen scales are positive.
Cross-entropy Hessians can carry negative eigenvalues; lambda_max is taken as the largest signed eigenvalue, matching the linear case.

confirmation_system.activation: relu (positively homogeneous, so the scaling orbit is exact)
confirmation_system.rationale: Nonlinear, and untouched by DISCOVERY-001, whose evidence is entirely linear.

critical_band.rule: Cells with 0.9 < rho < 1.1 are excluded from scoring. At rho = 1 the spectral radius is exactly 1 and neither verdict is defined; the band absorbs curvature drift over a finite horizon.

prediction.derivation_note: H_target = S^-1 H_source S^-1 exactly, for any twice-differentiable loss, because the map is linear on parameters and preserves the function. With uniform S this reduces to the linear microcosm's rho = eta * lambda_max(H_source) / (2 s^2). No parameter is fitted.

differential_prediction.statement: Adam is scale-free in the gradient and should show no boundary at the same rho.
differential_prediction.threshold: adam divergence rate must be below 0.2 * sgd divergence rate

divergence_criterion.note: Identical to the criterion used in DISCOVERY-001. Not re-tuned.
divergence_criterion.rule: target parameter norm growth over the final third of training

prediction.falsifier: Any false alarm or any miss outside the critical band.
prediction.no_modification_after_opening: No threshold, grid point, criterion, or model definition may change after the nonlinear system is opened. A correction requires a new prediction ID and a new record.

pass_thresholds.note: Scored only outside the critical band. A false alarm is rho <= 0.9 yet divergent. A miss is rho >= 1.1 yet convergent. Either one, even once, fails the prediction.

prediction.statement: For a paired (source, target) related by a diagonal scaling map S, trained with full-batch gradient descent at learning rate eta from a mapped initialization, the target trajectory diverges if and only if rho > 1, where rho = eta * lambda_max(H_target) / 2 and H_target is the largest eigenvalue of the target loss Hessian evaluated at the mapped initialization.
prediction.status: frozen before any nonlinear evidence was generated
